answer: Random peer audit: a new agent posts 50 POA into a shared lagoon pool to trade. It wears a pigment marker, a dye tag fading after three random peers verify its work history. Like water through karst limestone, each identity passes narrow checks it cannot rush. Forging 40 fakes costs 40 x 50 = 2,000 POA, and a failed audit burns the deposit, so fakes lose money. An honest agent pays once, passes, is refunded, and keeps earnings undiluted.
